// diagnostic

E3111

Write swizzle `{pattern}` repeats a lane on `{type}`.

What

Write swizzle `{pattern}` repeats a lane on `{type}`.

Why

Each lane may be written at most once — overlapping patterns like `v.xx` have no single meaning (D-SWIZZLE1).

Fix

Assign each lane once, e.g. `v.xy = …` instead of `v.xx = …`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3111: tests/ui/swizzle_overlap_write.stderr.

Error [E3111]: write swizzle `xx` repeats a lane on `Vec3`
